VIVARY · IDENTITY REVIEW · 2026-10-04

A proper name in the corner.

Three ways to replace the generic V with the existing path-drawn Vivary wordmark and a matching jar icon. The product name, letterforms and jar geometry stay intact. The mascot remains the separate project-agent character.

Proposals only. These files do not change the app, website or native package. The app strips below are labeled overlays on a real development capture, not screenshots of implemented changes. Original capture: October 3, before runtime sign-in.

What would change after a choice

The chosen header asset would replace the generic V/name treatment. The matching jar master would supply desktop, taskbar and browser icons. No mascot redesign, name, runtime behavior, permissions or release status changes are proposed.

Header canvases are intentionally tighter than the old print-oriented SVG clear space. The underlying path data stays exact. Component padding supplies surrounding space. This spacing adjustment and the A/C icon colors require review as proposals.

The source screenshot is the actual browser-rendered Workbench interface from PR #179 QA, not the September 22 Windows download. No private project content is visible.
